description: Turns the music off (musicId null), or switches to a track the person has already heard and approved, including one of this listing's generated tracks (list_generated_music). A new track goes through propose_music so the person can hear it first. Cuts re-sync to the new beat, and a track the person trimmed earlier keeps its trim. Uses no credit; undoable.

musicId.description: A track the person already heard and approved (list_music or list_generated_music), or null for no music.

name: set_music
title: Change music
